scope.profile: Generated C repair profile through scripted ACP and active repair validation
scope.coverage: The shared exact/retry fixture creates a multibyte source candidate of 4096 UTF-8 bytes and a 4097-byte retry whose character count remains below the grant. The source-file test requires exact byte authority and readback after denial; the staging test independently sets aggregate staging to unchanged context bytes plus 4096 and validates the same candidate bytes. Patch-byte and filesystem-write boundary controls also pass with this multibyte fixture. Receipt/assessment and source/head assertions remain part of the active tests.
